comment: The 3.5.3 bundle ceilings were 881096 CJS and 878096 ESM. The GridFS cross-operation ownership, durable session CAS/abort fencing, delete protection and idle-TTL migration add ~4.4/4.7 KiB over that ceiling (CI build 2026-11-12: 885536 CJS / 882819 ESM). Raise to 890000 / 887000, keeping ~4 KiB reviewed headroom; no dependency change. Enforce these ceilings in release preflight.
